message.pathlighter.unavailable: Pathlighter isn't installed on this server
pathlighter.configuration.allowAutoCraft: Whether players can auto-craft torches. When off, no player auto-crafts, whatever their own setting
pathlighter.configuration.autoCraft.tool: Craft four torches from one coal or charcoal and one stick when a player runs out
pathlighter.configuration.coalReserve.to: Coal and charcoal that auto-crafting always leaves in the inventory
pathlighter.configuration.enabledByDefau: Whether Pathlighter starts on for players who haven't toggled it themselves
pathlighter.configuration.enforcedGround: Blocks no player's torches are placed on, in addition to each player's own blacklist
pathlighter.configuration.groundBlacklis: Blocks torches are never placed on (e.g., 'minecraft:glass')
pathlighter.configuration.lightThreshold: Places a torch where the light at a player's feet is at or below this level (0-15)
pathlighter.configuration.minimumTorchSp: Smallest torch spacing a player can use. A player who chooses less gets this spacing
pathlighter.configuration.requireMiningT: Only place torches while holding a pickaxe, shovel, axe, or hoe
pathlighter.configuration.stickReserve.t: Sticks that auto-crafting always leaves in the inventory
pathlighter.configuration.title: Pathlighter Configuration
pathlighter.configuration.torchSpacing.t: Minimum distance in blocks between torches a player places
